results.objective: Laravel forwards the uploaded file to FastAPI /v1/validate and returns the contract response
results.preconditions: Local stack up; test account A; golden retail_sales.csv
results.steps: POST /analyses; POST /analyses/{id}/dataset (multipart); POST /analyses/{id}/validate; read analytics container log
results.expected: HTTP 200, valid=true, row_count 240, column_count 7; analytics log shows POST /v1/validate 200
results.actual: upload 201; validate 200; rows 240 cols 7; analytics log lines matching /v1/validate: 0

results.objective: Analysis state written by Laravel is persisted in PostgreSQL and read back through the API
results.steps: GET /analyses/{id}; GET /analyses; read-only psql select on analyses by public_id (local dev DB)
results.expected: API shows VALIDATED with counts; the same row exists in PostgreSQL with status VALIDATED, 240 rows, 7 columns
results.actual: API status VALIDATED, listed=True, postgres row: VALIDATED|240|7|retail_sales.csv

results.objective: FastAPI validates, profiles and analyses a valid CSV with the documented contract; engine mean cross-checked independently
results.preconditions: Analytics container up; internal token from local env
results.steps: POST /v1/validate, /v1/profile, /v1/analyze directly on 127.0.0.1:8001 with X-Internal-Token and metadata JSON
results.expected: All 200; valid=true 240 rows; 7 profiled columns; evidence_count>0; mean(revenue) equals statistics.fmean within 1e-9
results.actual: validate 200 valid=True rows=240; profile 200 cols=7; analyze 200 evidence=75 families=['descriptive', 'trend', 'group_comparison', 'association', 'quality', 'statistical_test']; mean match=True

results.objective: Invalid inputs are rejected with the defined validation responses at both service boundaries
results.preconditions: Analytics up; invalid input files in evidence/system/inputs
results.steps: FastAPI: header-only, empty, missing token, duplicate headers; Laravel: duplicate-header CSV validate, .txt upload
results.expected: FastAPI: valid=false with NO_DATA_ROWS; ANALYTICS_INVALID_DATASET; 401 without token; EMPTY_COLUMN_NAME+DUPLICATE_COLUMN. Laravel: 422 CSV_VALIDATION_FAILED; 422 for .txt
results.actual: header_only=200/True; empty=422/True; no_token=401; dup=True; laravel dup=422 CSV_VALIDATION_FAILED; txt=422

results.objective: Backend returns a controlled error when the analytics service is down and recovers after restart without false success
results.preconditions: Analysis UPLOADED; local analytics container stopped (failure injection on dev stack)
results.steps: docker compose stop analytics; POST validate; GET analysis; docker compose start analytics; wait /health; POST validate
results.expected: 5xx with error code ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE; status stays UPLOADED; after restart validate returns 200
results.actual: during outage HTTP 503 code=ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE msg='The analytics service is unavailable.'; status after=UPLOADED; healthy after restart=True; retry HTTP 200

results.objective: UI shows a controlled error during an analytics outage and recovers via Try again
results.preconditions: Same outage window as INT-06; logged-in browser session
results.steps: Upload golden CSV in the UI while analytics is stopped; observe error state; restart analytics; click Try again
results.expected: Error panel 'The upload did not go through' with Try again; no success message; after restart the retry validates the file
results.actual: error state shown=True; retry succeeded=True

results.objective: Backend retrieves completed analysis results associated with the right analysis
results.preconditions: A1 VALIDATED; worker and analytics up; local Ollama for suggestions
results.steps: POST profile; wait PROFILED; PUT definitions (accepted suggestions); POST run; wait ANALYZED; GET insights, visualizations, status; psql counts
results.expected: ANALYZED with job SUCCEEDED; insights and visualizations non-empty, each insight carries evidence keys; DB counts match the API
results.actual: final ANALYZED; insights 7 (9 evidence keys), charts 8; job SUCCEEDED; db evidence|insights|charts = 75|7|8
